zh: AI 对话支持生成图片：在「+」菜单开启「生成图片」，用文字描述想要的画面即可（Pro 专属）
生成的图片可全屏查看，支持分享、保存到相册与举报
模型能力标签「图片」改为「识图」，与生成图片区分开
en: AI chat can now generate images: turn on "Generate image" in the "+" menu and describe what you want (Pro only)
Generated images open full-screen and can be shared, saved to Photos, or reported
The "Image" capability tag is now "Vision", to tell it apart from image generation
